Our Mwihoko campus — classrooms, labs & transport under one roof
Who we are

A school built
for the whole child

Tumaini Valley Springs Schools delivers the Competency-Based Education (CBE) across Primary and Junior Secondary, with a mission to provide holistic, learner-centered education that encourages imagination and innovation for lifelong success.

From science and languages to sport and the arts, every learner is guided toward a pathway that fits who they are — not just what they can memorise.

Our motto

Imagine, Innovate, Inspire — the standard behind every lesson, club and school trip.

Our mission

To provide holistic, learner-centered education that encourages imagination and innovation, for lifelong success and inspiration.

CBE career pathways

Every subject leads
somewhere real

Our senior-school pathways wall maps every learning area to the careers it opens up — so learners choose subjects with a destination in mind, not just a subject name.

CBE
Pathways
Adapted from the Career Wheel on display in our JSS corridor
01

Pure & Applied Science

Mathematics, chemistry, biology and physics for future doctors, engineers and researchers.

02

Technical & Engineering

Power mechanics, electrical, wood and building technology — hands-on skills with real trades.

03

Languages & Literature

English, Kiswahili and Sign Language, building the communicators, writers and teachers of tomorrow.

04

Humanities & Business

History, geography, CRE and business studies for civic leaders, entrepreneurs and analysts.

05

Arts, Sports & Performing Arts

Music, dance, theatre and athletics — nurturing talent alongside academics.

On campus

Facilities that
back up the lesson

Practical learning spaces so pathway subjects are practiced, not just taught from a textbook.

Science Laboratory

Equipped bench space for chemistry, biology and physics practicals.

Computer Studies Lab

Digital literacy and computer studies from an early grade.

Library & Study Areas

Quiet space for reading, research and revision.

Sports Field

Athletics and ball games for the Sports pathway.

Music & Arts Room

Space for performing and visual arts learners to create.

Dining Hall

A shared space for meals across the school day.

Getting to school

Our own fleet,
our own drivers

Routes across Ruiru

A fleet of school buses and vans covers routes throughout Mwihoko, Ruiru and surrounding neighbourhoods.

Speed-limited & clearly marked

Every vehicle is signed "School Bus", speed-governed and identifiable on the road.

A watched campus

Gated grounds with CCTV coverage at the main entrance and compound.
